Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import time
nodes=0; memo=set(); sol=None; start=time.time(); ptypes=list(initial_counts)
def solve(rem, counts, path):
    global nodes, sol
    nodes+=1
    if not rem:
        if not any(counts.values()): sol=path.copy(); return True
        return False
    if nodes>3000000: return False
    key=(rem,tuple(counts[t] for t in ptypes))
    if key in memo:return False
    # choose most constrained unfilled cell, counting candidates
    best=None; bestopts=None
    temp=rem
    while temp:
        bit=temp & -temp; idx=bit.bit_length()-1; cell=(idx//10,idx%10); temp-=bit
        opts=[]
        for p in plac_by_cell[cell]:
            typ,_,_,_,_,mask=p
            if counts[typ] and (mask & rem)==mask:
                opts.append(p)
        if not opts:
            memo.add(key); return False
        if bestopts is None or len(opts)<len(bestopts):
            best,bestopts=cell,opts
            if len(opts)==1:break
    # placements covering chosen cell
    for p in bestopts:
        typ=p[0]
        counts[typ]-=1
        if solve(rem ^ p[5], counts, path+[p]): return True
        counts[typ]+=1
    memo.add(key)
    return False
ok=solve(allmask,initial_counts.copy(),[])
